notes.title: Patchnotes 3rd of August
notes.content:
Dear Farmers of Tomorrow,

We hope that you are all doing ok in this heat (lucky you if you live in the southern hemisphere!). Here are the details of today’s update : 

BUG FIX



  Fixed translation issues in the tutorial dialogue of the pig farming region. We are sorry that this change took so long, we will do our best to fix other localisation issues as they come.
  Due to performance issues, we have lowered the number of fields in the pig farming region. From now on, all new games will start with 10 fields, existing saves will keep their 41 fields until the end of the game. We have implemented a pop-up in game to inform you of this change.
  Because there are now fewer fields in the pig farming region, we have adjusted the size of the fields : overall they will have more hectares.
  Implemented a new save system that is more stable overall
  Fixed the issue where after purchasing a DLC, loading a save would cause problems. However, please keep in mind that DLCs do not activate in saves previous to their purchase.
  Fixed the issue where the “Covers” action would be required again aver loading a save
  Fixed the issue where the “Feed” action in the permanent pastures of the cattle farming region didn’t require a precision spreader
  Replaced “units” by “kg” in the confirmation window for buying and selling in the marketplace
  Fixed the issue where training an employee while having negative cashflow would give money.
 Fixed the issue where upgrades that led to lower work time on certain actions were not registered in saves.


STRATEGIC CHOICES MAJOR BUG FIX

Generally speaking, there were many problems with strategic choices as to the fulfillment of their objectives. Here is a list of all the issues we have fixed : 

Pig Farming Region


 Increase in UAA (1) : the objective of possessing 60 ha of agricultural land was always fulfilled, no matter the actual amount of agricultural land possessed.
 Improve feed independence :  the objective of possessing 70 ha of agricultural land was always fulfilled, no matter the actual amount of agricultural land possessed.

 Soil conservation : the in-game objective was to have a score of at least 3/5 in soil management. However, it was too high compared to what the Game Designers had planned. The minimum score is now set at 2.5/5
 Increase in UAA (2) : the objective of possessing 70 ha of agricultural land was always fulfilled, no matter the actual amount of agricultural land possessed.
 Organic crops : The following perk : “The price of your harvested crops is now 15% higher” now works as intended
 Purple label : The following perk : “The price of your slaughter pigs is now 0,15 € higher for each kg” now works as intended
 Organic Pigs : The following perk : “The price of your slaughter pigs is now 1,40 € higher for each kg” now works as intended
 Physical Direct Sales : the objective of 15 000 € in sales now works as intended
 Tourism on the farm : The following perk "Tourism revenue is increased by 1000 euros per month" now works as intended


Sheep Farming Region


 Improve feed independence :  the objective of possessing 50 ha of agricultural land was always fulfilled, no matter the actual amount of agricultural land possessed.
 Income diversification : The objective of selling 10 000 € of crops in the allocated time now works as intended
 Income diversification : The following perk “The price of all seeds are decreased by 5% for the rest of the game” now works as intended.
 Organic crops : The following perk : “The price of your harvested crops is now 15% higher” now works as intended
 Organic Lambs : “The price of your slaughter lambs is now 0,35 € higher for each kg” now works as intended
 Purple label : The following perk : “The price of your slaughter lambs is now 0,30 € higher for each kg” now works as intended
 Lavender cultivation :The objective of selling 10 000 € of crops in the allocated time now works as intended
 Lavender cultivation :The following perk “Unlock the purchase of lavender in the seed section of the Market.” now works as intended
 Lavender cultivation :The following perk “Your lavender production sells for 30% more in the Market for the rest of the game.” now works as intended
 Physical Direct Sales : the objective of 15 000 € in sales now works as intended
 Rural Tourism : The objective to earn 15 000 € in tourism income in the allocated time now works as intended 
 Multiple income sources : The objective of selling 15 000 €  of lamb, 5 000 € of lavender, 5000 € of tourism income now works as intended   
 Low carbon commitment : The objective of installing at least one solar panel now works as intended. 



Cattle Farming Region


 Improve feed independence :  the objective of possessing 60 ha of agricultural land was always fulfilled, no matter the actual amount of agricultural land possessed.
 Income diversification : The objective of selling 10 000 € of crops in the allocated time now works as intended
 Income diversification : The following perk “The price of all seeds are decreased by 5% for the rest of the game” now works as intended.
 Organic crops : The following perk : “The price of your harvested crops is now 50% higher” now works as intended
 Organic farrming : “The price of your cattle is now 15% higher” now works as intended
 Purple label : The following perk : “The price of your cattle is now 10% higher” now works as intended
 Physical Direct Sales : the objective of 15 000 € in sales now works as intended
 Rural Tourism : The objective to earn 15 000 € in tourism income in the allocated time now works as intended 
 Multiple income sources : The objective of selling 15 000 €  of cattle, 10 000 € of products from your shop, 5000 € of crops now works as intended   


NEW


 Added new region selection screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/774bbd790ef5eec24b7807ba52585f3d4869cc6f.png
 Added illustrations in the background of UI elements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/138f3d4ce252a6241e580179c6579bd060800fdb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/6b4a41c058d57dc8109cd1aa78446bf4c97730ac.png


Join our Discord or Follow us on social media if you want to stay updated on future content.
And as always, we’re always open to your feedbacks, comments and suggestions

Thank you again for your support!

The Gamabilis Team

notes.title: 5000 Farmers of Tomorrow !
notes.content:
We just hit 5000 downloads on Steam!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/677227f3956f0d3808c0c42319efb9204a3cba3e.png


Although this number may seem insignificant compared to other games, it's a great milestone for us, a small indie studio that never published anything on Steam before.

We want to thank each and every one of you for downloading our game. Not only because it makes all our team proud of their work, but also because it means that 5000 gamers showed that they actually care about sustainable agriculture.

Here at Gamabilis, we strive to make games with a positive impact on the world.

Our hope is that Roots of Tomorrow made you a little more aware of how agriculture has an impact on our environment, but also on the lives of farmers today.

Thank you again for supporting a small indie game that's trying to make the world a little bit better!

We hope that our future updates will live up to your expectations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/f362580d0a24ad56e2bceffea4fc1cc0acaa449d.png

notes.title: Roots of Tomorrow English Version is Live !
notes.content:
Dear Farmers of Tomorrow,

Roots of Tomorrow’s English Release is finally here! 
All the team wants to thank you for being patient.
This new update not only contains English localization, but also brings the Early Access phase to its end!
To celebrate this day, we prepared a brand new trailer for you!

[previewyoutube=O3Hx6Gp6lPg;full][/previewyoutube]

IMPORTANT

This update will render past saves obsolete. Playing on an old save after this update may cause significant gameplay issues. We highly recommend that you start a new save after this update.

BUG FIX



  Deactivated cursor during cinematic cutscenes
  Fixed the text displayed on the “Low Carbon” strategic choice in the Cattle Farming Region. The goal set by the strategic choice is now to build at least one solar panel
  Fixed the problem where certain strategic choices would lead to corrupt saves


NEW


 Added achievements
 Graphical change : crops are now displayed in rows on fields
 Graphical change : each crop now has its own 3D model on fields
 Added a recap of all scores after a “Victory” ending.
 English localization


DLCs

We prepared a few DLCs to go with this release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/4e12dca51eeb76580751441188c71f5b3e8ae553.png

A Beekeeping DLC, which will allow you to install beehives on all farms, produce/sell honey and preserve biodiversity. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/d8f43c844384b88e5f8512123349a91bacc7f456.png

An additional characters DLC, which offers 4 additional characters with unique perks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/f9e242dde6388422777d6c8b7f5d277c90bca936.png

A season pass, which offers the two previous DLCs an upcoming expansion : Urban Agriculture 

This expansion will be set in the outskirts of a city, where you will be able to grow a variety of produce (vegetables, fruits, edible flowers and salads) on buildings, parks, and green spaces. 

BUY A DLC = SAVE THE BEES !

Because Roots of Tomorrow is a game about agroecology, it was important to us to support the preservation of biodiversity.

This is why part of the income generated by the sales these DLCs will be donated to the non profit “Un toit pour les abeilles” (“A roof for bees”)

“Un Toit Pour Les Abeilles” is a network of nearly a hundred beekeepers who campaign for artisanal, local and bee-friendly beekeeping. For more than 10 years, the beekeepers of the network have been committed to safeguarding the bee, in particular through the sponsorship of beehives.

Click Here for more info 


FUTURE UPDATES

We are currently working on the next FREE EXPANSION of the game.
This new farm will be set in the Normandy region of France. This whole expansion will be centered around dairy farming. Here’s a sneak peak of the farm (WIP of course)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/fed2a3135a74013b90c9a0b8410d034b9c8b8995.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/9c4c9e5fcfbe25f25c38767ac6ba5be4ddee0c3a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/42fdc02fa39a7330dd1cae85af73319efc9d9ee8.png


Join our Discord or Follow us on social media if you want to stay updated on future content.
And as always, we’re always open to your feedbacks, comments and suggestions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/f362580d0a24ad56e2bceffea4fc1cc0acaa449d.png

We hope that you enjoy yourselves on your sustainable farm !

The Gamabilis Team

notes.title: Roots of Tomorrow available in English May 11th !
notes.content:
Dear Farmers of Tomorrow, 

The long wait is soon over !

It is with great pleasure that we announce Roots of Tomorrow will finally be playable in English on May 11th. This date will also mark the end of its Early Access phase. We would like all of you for being patient and understanding!

Our developers have been constantly improving the game over the past few months. The next update on May 11th will bring even more bug fixes and new features!

What's next ?

Even after Early Access ends, we will continue to improve and expand the game with your suggestions and feedback. The team is currently working on the next FREE expansion: The Normandy region, with its dairy cows. 
More info very soon! Don't forget to follow us on social media or join our Discord to find out more!

DLC

And now a quick word on DLCs, on May 11th, Roots Of Tomorrow’s English Release will also be accompanied by two DLCs. One DLC will unlock beekeeping on all farms, the other will give access to 4 exclusive characters with new character traits.

Because Roots of Tomorrow is a game about agroecology, it was important to us to support the preservation of biodiversity.

This is why part of the income generated by the sales of the beehive DLC will be donated to the non profit “Un toit pour les abeilles” (“A roof for bees”)

“Un Toit Pour Les Abeilles” is a network of nearly a hundred beekeepers who campaign for artisanal, local and bee-friendly beekeeping. For more than 10 years, the beekeepers of the network have been committed to safeguarding the bee, in particular through the sponsorship of beehives.

Click Here for more info 

We look forward to seeing you on farms all over France on May 11th 🚜

Team Gamabilis 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41067053/f362580d0a24ad56e2bceffea4fc1cc0acaa449d.png

notes.title: Patchnotes 21st of January 2022
notes.content:
Dear Farmers of Tomorrow,

First of all, Happy New Year! Best wishes for this year 2022. We hope it will be filled with opportunities for you :). Unfortunately, the English version is not available but is getting closer and closer ! 

This week, we focused on improving the sheep farming scenario in the South Region: Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. We have also added new features that should improve your gaming experience! Lots of bugs fixed too, thanks to our players on our Discord who helped us spot them!

IMPORTANT

We strongly advise you to start a new game after this update as it is unfortunately not retroactive. Thus, loading old saves may cause significant gameplay problems.

Improvement of the sheep farming region


 Dialogues: dialogues with NPCs have been added
 Tutorial: the tutorial for sheep breeding has been added
 Addition of the mountain pasture
 Addition of Orchard


New features


 Options: it is now possible to modify the graphic resolutions as well as the sound volume
 Finance: possibility of establishing the rate of repayment and the time before starting the repayment of a loan.
 Main character: the list of his skills as well as his overall level have been reworked
Each icon indicates a skill, as well as the character's level and experience in that skill. When you click on a tile, a training pop-in opens allowing you to improve this skill.
 The seed calendar: in the purchase menu, it is now possible to see the sowing and harvesting periods for each seed.


Rebalancing indicators


 The Renew action of the pig building lowered the “Energy Consumption” indicator a little too much (0.05 each time). The indicator is now down 0.02 points.
 The "Sowing with ploughing" technique of the Sow action lowered the "Soil management" and "Preservation of biodiversity" indicators too much, these indicators will now be lowered by 0.005
 The “Synthetic Fertilizer” technique of the Feed action lowered the “Soil Management” and “Preservation of Biodiversity” indicators too much, these indicators  will now be lowered by 0.005
 The “Enhanced Protection” technique of the Protect action lowered the “Soil Management” and “Preservation of Biodiversity” indicators too much, these indicators  will now be lowered by 0.005
 The external renewal technique of the Renew action of the pig house lowered the “Energy consumption” indicator too much. this indicator  will now be lowered by 0.015
 All solar panels in the maternity ward go from €15,000 to €50,000 (same for the Heritage indicator). All the solar panels in the pig building go from €37,500 to €80,000 (same for the Heritage indicator). The prices were too low.



Bug fixes


 Loading a save no longer resets scores and insurance
 Pig building renew action no longer crashes the game
 The house administrative action no longer blocks the game
 Market: the page opens when there is no more seed
 The camera no longer moves by itself when closing the purchase popup
 An emplyee who ends his/her contract returns to the list of characters to recruit


That's it for this update! Thanks again for your continued support for our game. Feel free to join our discord or follow us on social media to chat with us about the game!

-The Gamabilis Team

notes.title: Game expansion : Sheep Farming in the southern Region of France
notes.content:
Dear Farmers of Tomorrow,

Although the English version of the game is not live yet, we want to keep you updated on the development of the game. Which is why this week, we are pleased to unveil our first game expansion! It is none other than our sheep farming scenario set in the Southern Region of France : Provence-Alpes-Côte-d´Azur! New buildings, new actions,  many surprises await!



IMPORTANT

This update will render past saves obsolete. Playing on an old save after this update may cause significant gameplay issues. We highly recommend that you start a new save after this update.

New actions and buildings related to sheep farming:


 Sheepfold: this is the main building where you will take care of your sheep (lambing, feeding, shearing, selling etc.). Unlock more actions by upgrading it!
 Individual routes: herds not only graze on meadows but also on “individual routes”. An improvement is possible to enlarge your routes.
 Bed and breakfast: create a space to welcome tourists and diversify your activities!


New random events to spice up your gaming experience:


 Predation: Be careful, this does not happen often, but your sheep may be vulnerable to this kind of situation. Keep a lookout!


New strategic choices


 Organic lamb: Add value to your herd by transitioning to a better environmental model. The selling price of your lamb will increase.
 Cultivating Lavender
 GPS collars to easily find the herd and improve working conditions (saving time). It only takes 3 or 4 to follow the whole herd out in the pastures and mountains.
 Biosecurity: Used to strengthen certain prevention techniques (quarantine, vaccination, traceability) for the care of the herd.
 Energy autonomy: Produce your own energy to gain autonomy and save money in the long term.
 Internet presence: Having a good presence on the Internet (site, social networks) allows you to give more visibility to your activities.
 Ventilation: A static ventilation system, adapted to your sheepfold, improves the performance and health of your herd.
 Barn ventilation: add an extension to your barn with an improved barn ventilation system, and a mechanical arm. This improves working conditions and also results in better quality hay.
 Wwoofing (World-Wide Opportunities on Organic Farms): Wwoofers are tourists that you welcome free of charge in exchange for services in the sheepfold. It won’t help you cut down on work time, but it will help raise awareness around your activity.



Research


 Associative wrapping: Allows to donate part of the purchase price of plastic wrapping (for hay bales) to a non-profit. Passer-bys are intrigued by these different colored bales of hay and inquire about this non-profit.


Graphical updates


 Button design, renewed loading screen, interface windows have been redesigned.


Minor bug Corrections


 Main characters salary isn’t locked at 2€ anymore
 Score indicators have been balanced
 Text corrections for the Protect action
 Strategic choices
 Fixed slowdowns when passing a turn after some time of gameplay
 Scores are now correctly saved to find them back when loading a game
 You can’t assign work to a character once they have passed 160% of wokload
 The best selling contract is now selected by default when selling


That is all for this update. Thank you for your continued interest in our game. The English Version will come early next year and we cannot wait for you all to try it.

Happy holidays and stay safe !

The Gamabilis Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 1st December 2021
notes.content:
Dear Farmers of Tomorrow,

Although the English version of the game is not available yet, our team is working hard on improving it every day ! 

Today, we wanted to share our progress with you. 
Our first update mainly consists of bug fixes (reported to us by players on our Discord) and a few new functionalities.

IMPORTANT

For those of you who may have tested the game in its current French version, we highly recommend that you start a new save after this update as it will render your existing saves obsolete. Playing on an old save after this update may cause significant gameplay issues.

As we are still in Early Access, updates may affect existing saves. We are very sorry about this but it unfortunately cannot be avoided in this case. To enjoy the game without issues, creating a new save is the only solution during the game's early access phase. We will do our best to fix this problem for the official release of the game.

NEW FEATURES

New tutorial 


 Instructions have been made clearer (flashing icons, new dialog). 

 The option to skip the tutorial at the beginning of a new game has been added (Don't worry, Jean-Baptiste won't be mad)


New buildings 


 On-site feed manufacturing  

This new building will allow you to manufacture feed more efficiently for your pigs. It can be unlocked through the research tree.
 
 On-site store 

You can now sell your products directly on the farm instead of using the marketplace. The store is on the left side of the map and is buyable at the start of the game.



BUG FIXES

Buildings


 The auto renewal of pigs has been fixed

 The solar panels on the maternity building now have to be unlocked through research to become available.

 The maternity building has been fixed

 The slurry treatment plant is now buyable at the start of the game (instead of immediately being available)


Team


 Wage negotiation : you cannot offer a negative wage anymore (unfortunately)

 Recruitment : the issue where employees who stayed even after after their contract expired has been fixed.

 Firing a team member who was assigned a repeatable task will not cause the game to freeze anymore.
 


Inventory


 The price of slurry has been reduced 


Marketplace


 The quantity input bar in the Marketplace menu will not move anymore when the quantity is too high 

 Fixed the sales contracts

 The quantity of seeds needed to sow on a field will automatically be displayed while buying them.   


Finance


 When upgrading or buying a new building, the loan amount will automatically be displayed (no need to use the slider anymore. 

 Two new financial products have been added
 
 Subsidies have been added during the first two years


Balancing


 Rebalanced the impact of the workload on employee mood and endurance.
 The workload of the team will now be calculated according to the assigned tasks


Menu navigation


 Mouse scrolling through the different menu tabs now works as intended


OTHER

Optimization 


 The general performance of the game and its loading times have been improved


Movement


 Movement on the farm and on the minimap have been improved


Save Load


 Many actions did not work after loading a save previously. This is no longer the case for new saves. Existing saves won't be affected by this change and can therefore still create issues. Only new saves created after this update will work as intended (see above)


Thank you again for your interest in the game. The English version of the game is coming early 
2022 !

- The Gamabilis Team

notes.title: Roots of Tomorrow is available in Early Access on October 21st!
notes.content:
IMPORTANT: Roots of Tomorrow is currently only available in French, however localization will take place soon

Hi there! Team Gamabilis here!

We are thrilled to announce that Roots of Tomorrow will be available in Early Access on October 21st.
Although the game itself is not available in English yet, we would like to share our progress by showing what features of the game will be available in this version:


Actions on breeding buildings (selling, upgrading, treating, renewing, feeding)
Actions on others buildings and places such as: house, farrowing building, fields,...
A tutorial for the main features
Finance menu to manage your cash flow, loans and insurances
Market to buy/sell seeds, materiel, fields and livestock
Human resources to manage your character and your employees
Investing in agricultural research for the future
Inventory
Characters perks (bonus)
Original music made according to each Region (for now, only for the first scenario)
Saving system
Events 
Weather System
Buying fields


We are truly sorry that English speakers won't be able to play the game yet but we promise that we are trying our best to give you a translated version as soon as we can.
